## What's Changed
* fix #563: ネイティブ JSON オブジェクト入力を配列として受理する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1250
* fix #566: layout_tree不一致detailsに差分の単位を明記 by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1261
* fix #570: layout_tree の max_details を構造化配列にも適用する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1274
* fix #573: strictのdiff_regions切り詰めをdiff_regions_totalで通知する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1275
* fix #578: layout_integrity の issues に edge/overflow_px/parent_selector を追加する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1286
* fix #585: initializeエラー応答を捨てず即時にrejectする by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1298
* fix #587: layout_tree の一致ペアを matched_pairs として返す by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1302
* fix #591: diff_on_mismatchを比較前にboolArgで厳密検証する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1306
* fix #589: CLIエラーにMCPパラメータ対応のフラグ名ヒントを追加 by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1311
* fix #592: 画像デコード失敗メッセージの二重実装を解消 by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1316


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/compare/v1.0.5...v1.0.6

## What's Changed
* fix #516: CLIの--helpをstdoutへ出す by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1137
* fix #515: 除外誤用フィールドを Step 6 の確認対象に追加 by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1138
* fix #523: layout_integrity の無効な代替ヒント案内を止める by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1160
* fix #526: 不一致詳細に比較空間 space を明示する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1161
* fix #527: layout_integrity の max_details で issues も切り詰める by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1171
* fix #543: layout_integrity の入力検証を layout_tree と同じ経路として文書・テストを揃える by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1208
* fix #548: 真偽値フラグの空白区切り誤用を文書化しテストを強化 by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1218
* fix #550: READMEのCLI終了コード説明にskippedを明記する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1219
* fix #555: 零サイズ除外件数を layout_integrity 応答に載せる by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1233
* fix #557: ignore_nodesの一致判定を共通ヘルパーに集約 by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1234


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/compare/v1.0.4...v1.0.5

## What's Changed
* fix #440: 親検査スキップ時に parent_checked_nodes 診断を返す by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1044
* fix #491: NaN数値引数を有限値エラーとして明示拒否する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1067
* fix #496: layout_integrity の非対応一覧に diff_on_mismatch を追加 by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1084
* fix #499: strict の generate_diff=false でも diff_regions を返す by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1085
* fix #498: layout_integrity のゼロ幾何過半数に警告を付ける by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1092
* fix #507: layout_tree 手順にレイアウト JSON のパス指定を追加 by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1114
* fix #508: threshold 0 でも mismatched_pairs に tolerance を残す by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1119
* fix #509: isUniformGray の説明コメントを関数直上へ移す by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1124
* fix #514: --mode未指定時に有効モードとUsageを案内する by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1128


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/compare/v1.0.3...v1.0.4

## What's Changed
* ci: npm への公開を Trusted Publishing（OIDC）に切り替える by @TomokiMatsubuchi in https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/pull/1038


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TomokiMatsubuchi/design-compare/compare/v1.0.2...v1.0.3

issues.title: CLI にインライン JSON の --figma-layout / --web-layout を追加する
mismatched_pairs で tolerance が 0 のとき tolerance フィールドが消える
ignore_nodes / ignore_region が文字列以外で渡されると無言で除外されない
CLI の --help が usage を stderr にだけ出すため、stdout をパイプするとヘルプが空になる
画像パス読み込みがファイルサイズ無制限で、誤ったパスを渡すと MCP サーバーが OOM する
CLI ワンショットに layout JSON のインライン指定（--figma-layout / --web-layout）が無く、一時ファイルが必須
